observations: Role 610 represents round tower shells with inner radius derived by subtracting wall thickness and connects a matching crown if present. The actual tower dimension admission, shape consumer and crown completeness determine whether an invalid inner radius or missing bond is reachable.

Roles 611, 613–615 derive fixed small-church dimensions from kind and size, build its separately authored storey and roofs, and assemble fittings, belfry members and public route. Fixed finite dimensions narrow several arithmetic concerns, but caller programme/roof-pitch admission, final support graph and collision remain open.

Role 613 chooses parent nodes from broad overlap of existing solid bounds, creates support records and casts a wall count into a bay ordinal. The source body alone does not prove physical contact, a reachable ordinal overflow or a defective supported generated plan. Its fallible builder may mutate local structures before an error; caller ownership and return semantics govern whether that state escapes.
